name: Input Buffer (Configurable)
description: Tick-based press and release input buffer with per-gamemode settings.

buffer-enabled.name: Enabled
buffer-enabled.description: Master switch for the input buffer.

debug-log.name: Debug logging
debug-log.description: Write a line to the Geode log whenever a delayed release is applied.

ground-ticks.name: Cube / Ball / Robot / Spider
ground-ticks.description: A press made while airborne is held for at least this many ticks, so a jump pressed slightly before landing still fires on landing. 0 = off. At 240 ticks/sec: 4 ticks = 1 frame @ 60 FPS.

wave-ticks.name: Wave
wave-ticks.description: Minimum hold time for a wave press. A release that comes sooner is delayed until this many ticks have passed. 0 = off.

ship-ticks.name: Ship
ship-ticks.description: Minimum hold time for a ship press. 0 = off (recommended: extra hold time means extra thrust).

ufo-ticks.name: UFO
ufo-ticks.description: Minimum hold time for a UFO press. 0 = off.

swing-ticks.name: Swing
swing-ticks.description: Minimum hold time for a swing press. 0 = off.
